relationship_to_dataset_v2.explanation: A separate, immutable artifact with its own lock. Dataset V2 keeps every byte and every canonical digest it was frozen with. The two series are combined only at load time, never merged on disk.
relationship_to_dataset_v2.disjoint: The overlay ends 2020-11-30T23:00:00Z; Dataset V2 begins 2020-12-01T00:00:00Z. No candle exists in both, so no Dataset V2 value can be overwritten by the join.
relationship_to_dataset_v2.never_scored: The overlay lies entirely before the Development window opens on 2021-01-01, so it contributes indicator history and nothing else.

acquisition.route: the same data.binance.vision public archive route that acquired Dataset V2; no exchange credential is used or required

warmup_budget.note: The requirement is 1300 VALID COMPLETED candles, not 1300 rows. The overlay must pass the full acquisition audit before its candles may be counted toward the budget.

required_checks: overlap policy is explicit and enforced

canonical_identity_gate.rule: After the overlay is joined, every Dataset V2 candle must still hash to the CANONICAL_CANDLE_V1 digest recorded in research/datasets/dataset_v2.lock.json.
canonical_identity_gate.on_failure: the run stops; the joined series is discarded
canonical_identity_gate.why: This is the property that makes the overlay safe rather than merely well-intentioned. It is asserted as a gate on every run, not argued once in prose. A join that moved any scored candle would silently invalidate BASELINE-1 as a comparison control.
per_run_proofs: overlay candles are strictly pre-score (all timestamps < first scored Development candle)
overlap policy is explicit (see overlap_policy) and enforced
no scored Dataset V2 candle is replaced by an overlay candle
every scored Dataset V2 candle still hashes to its frozen CANONICAL_CANDLE_V1 digest
research/datasets/dataset_v2.lock.json is byte-identical to its frozen state
canonical_identity_gate.lock_byte_identity: Beyond candle digests, the Dataset V2 lock FILE itself must not change. A lock edited to accommodate the overlay would defeat the whole arrangement while every candle digest still matched.

integrity_contract.note: Identical definition to Dataset V2's, so the two artifacts are directly comparable.

does_not_apply_to.BASELINE1_FROZEN_CONTROL: BASELINE-1 declares startup_candle_count=600 and is satisfied by Dataset V2's own 744 pre-Development candles. Its frozen records are not re-run and not altered.

gate_is_candle_count_not_calendar: The gate is VALID_COMPLETED_1H_CANDLES >= 1300 before the first scored Development candle. The 2020-10-01 start is the current intended window, not the requirement. If the audit rejects candles, the window extends backwards until 1300 VALID completed candles exist - the date does not certify the count.

overlap_policy.statement: The overlay ends 2020-11-30T23:00:00Z; Dataset V2 begins 2020-12-01T00:00:00Z.
overlap_policy.on_overlap: If any overlay candle ever shares a timestamp with a Dataset V2 candle, the Dataset V2 candle wins unconditionally and the overlay candle is discarded. Asserted per run rather than assumed from the dates.
